decisions.sub: How Jev and the LLM answer the bot's questions, and the rules that choose who decides.
decisions.empty: No decisions in this period yet.

mode_hint.jev: Jev answers; below the threshold — the action on the right.
mode_hint.llm: only the LLM of the “decide” role answers (if it fails — Jev). Slower and more expensive.
mode_hint.shadow: Jev's answer is used, and the LLM answers the same question in parallel. Both go to the log, so you can see how often they agree. Costs an LLM call per message.

below_hint.safe: The LLM is not asked. Jev's unsure answer is read with care: «answered in full» counts as «in part», a check of the answer's quality counts as passed; what cannot be read so is no answer, the bot asks the client. The LLM answers only when Jev gives no answer at all (an error, a timeout).
below_hint.llm: the question is asked again to the LLM, its answer is used.
below_hint.keep: Jev's answer is used anyway (cheap and fast, but may be wrong).
below_hint.ask_client: the answer counts as not given: the bot asks the client to clarify.
below_hint.operator: as “ask again”, and the reply of this message goes to an operator to choose.

decisions.spread_hint: Each bar is a 0.05 step of Jev's confidence (how sure it was). The green part is the share of answers the LLM agreed with.
decisions.bar: {from}–{to}: {n} answers, the LLM agrees in {agree} of {pairs}
decisions.sim_agree_above: Above the threshold Jev and the LLM agree in {pct} ({n} compared)
decisions.sim_agree_below: Below the threshold they agree in {pct} ({n} compared)
decisions.sim_no_pairs: Nothing to compare yet: switch this question to “Jev + LLM comparison” for a few days.
decisions.disagreements: Where Jev and the LLM disagree
decisions.keys_hint: Numbered questions (cand:1, cand:2…) are shown as one row (cand:*). LLM confidence is not calibrated, so thresholds apply to Jev only.
decisions.rules_sub: A rule applies to the questions whose key matches the pattern: an exact key or * as a wildcard (start:*, filter:booking.*). The exact key wins, then the longest pattern. Without a rule: Jev, threshold {threshold}, Jev's careful answer below it (the LLM only when Jev fails). Changes work from the next message.
decisions.shared_hint: A tenant rule with the same pattern replaces the shared one.
decisions.saved: Rules saved. They work from the next message.
decisions.show_label: Condition of the question “{field}” in the scenario {scenario} (sign {sign})
